items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Yeah, he was a great piano player... Of course Red Caillou was around my age, Red Caillou.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a great piano player. They had another piano player they called Nune. He was some kin to the Caillus. Yeah, he was a good piano player. They had the Red Caillou. What was here he was very good. Red Caillou. Yeah, he went to California, he died in California, in Oakland. He was a very good piano player. Of course Red Caillou was around my age, Red Caillou. Then they had another piano player here, what was a good piano player, Summersler Rouse. Now he, well see Summersler Rouse he was a good piano…
I didn't really know about him.
